description: A blanket `except Exception: return 0` masks distinct failures (missing file, corrupt/non-integer contents) as a silent zero, so callers can't distinguish 'no data' from 'broken data' and downstream counts are silently wrong.

expected.note: the defect is the whole try/except construct (lines 2-6): a broad catch returning a silent default. A reviewer may anchor on the `try` (line 2), the `except` (line 5), or the `return 0` (line 6) — all are the same finding. Keywords guard against crediting an unrelated co-located finding.
